jobs.title: AWS Redshift Data Engineer
jobs.description: Hi, Trust you are doing well! Please do share your resume if you are interested in this role. Job Description: AWS Redshift Data Engineer Location: Richardson, TX Type: Contract Job Description We are looking for an experienced AWS Redshift Data Engineer with expertise in AWS cloud services, data warehousing, ETL/data integration, and L3 application production support. The ideal candidate will have strong experience with Amazon Redshift, Informatica, AutoSys, Python, SQL/PL-SQL, and enterprise application support. Key Responsibilities - Develop, maintain, and optimize data pipelines and data warehouse solutions using Amazon Redshift and Redshift Spectrum. - Build and support ETL workflows using Informatica, AutoSys, Python, and SQL/PL-SQL. - Work with AWS services, including S3, RDS, Lambda, ECS/ECR, EventBridge, and CloudWatch Logs. - Perform L3 production support, incident troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and issue resolution. - Support Oracle databases and enterprise data warehousing environments. - Develop and maintain Java/Spring Boot applications, RESTful APIs, and microservices. - Monitor application performance, troubleshoot logs, and manage code changes using GitLab and nginx. - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure data quality, system reliability, and smooth production operations. Must-Have Skills - AWS Cloud and Amazon Redshift/Redshift Spectrum - Informatica and AutoSys - Python, SQL, and PL/SQL - EDW, Data Warehousing, and ETL/Data Integration - L3 Application/Production Support - AWS S3, RDS, Lambda, ECS/ECR, EventBridge, and CloudWatch - Oracle Database Nice-to-Have Skills - Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, Microservices, and J2EE - AI/ML and document intelligence technologies - Experience processing unstructured data and documents - Cloud-based data-processing platforms - Experience supporting complex enterprise data and application ecosystems

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Introduction A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences. Your Role And Responsibilities Data Engineer embedded with the client's teams to design and deliver hands-on solutions on the AWS/Databricks platform. The role combines architecture and engineering, and you will build and prove solutions with the client. Work includes re-engineering legacy data workloads and supporting data migration from MySQL to Databricks Lakebase. Responsibilities Work onsite or embedded with client teams to understand business problems and turn them into working technical solutions. Design and build data pipelines and integrations using Fivetran, Databricks, and AWS services. Lead technical design and delivery for migrating a Tier-1 application from MySQL to Databricks Lakebase, including schema re-design, data migration, cutover, and validation. Integrate SAP data through SAP BTP and BDC Connect, non-SAP data, and design domain centric data products. Build prototypes and reference implementations, then work with the client to harden them for production. Support data and AI use cases, including integration with GCP-based ML/GenAI components. Establish engineering standards: CI/CD, testing, observability, security, and cost control. Coach client and delivery team members, and communicate status, risks, and design decisions to stakeholders. Design end-to-end data solutions across multiple platforms, applying industry standards and best practices to meet client needs. Lead the development of data platform architectures, including cognitive components and unstructured data technologies, annotation, and related data and analytics. Manage and maintain large data repositories, ensuring scalability and performance. Create data solutions on cloud-native platforms (AWS, with GCP for ML/GenAI), tailored to client requirements. Collaborate with clients to understand their needs and deliver customized data solutions that meet their business objectives. This job can be performed from anywhere in the US Required Technical And Professional Expertise Must be able to travel 4 days per week (mandatory). Databricks Certified Data Engineer or Machine Learning Professional. Advanced hands-on expertise in data engineering and solution architecture, with demonstrated ability to design and deliver complex data solutions. Strong hands-on expertise with Databricks (Spark, Delta Lake, MLflow, Unity Catalog), AWS, SQL, and Python, including large-scale batch and streaming workloads. Experience with relational databases such as MySQL, database migration/re-engineering, Fivetran or similar ingestion/ELT technologies, and modern data-sharing patterns. Experience with Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, and other open table formats, including schema evolution, optimisation, and interoperability across engines. Hands-on experience designing scalable data platforms and pipelines using technologies such as Kafka, Amazon EventBridge, or Amazon SQS, along with Terraform and CI/CD practices. Preferred Technical And Professional Experience Experience with Databricks Lakebase or similar managed PostgreSQL/OLTP-on-lakehouse technologies. Knowledge of SAP BTP, BDC Connect, SAP extraction patterns, or SAP IS-U. Exposure to GCP ML/GenAI services and cloud-native solution design across AWS and GCP. Experience with Git-based version control and branching strategies for data workloads. Experience in the utilities or energy industry, with relevant Databricks and/or AWS certification.
